rows.grounds: indeclinable comparative adverb referring to prior procedure
object of the ritual action to be arranged
absolutive of pra-kḷp followed by indeclinable atha
ritual movement performed around the specified objects

items.question: What purification and circumambulation must be performed after feeding the brahmins?
premises: Purification is to be arranged as before.
The purification concerns the village and related entities.
A clockwise circumambulation of these entities must be performed.
items.inference: After feeding the brahmins, one must arrange the prior purification and perform a clockwise circumambulation of the village and related entities.
uncertainties: The exact scope of grāmādīnāṃ beyond the village is not specified.
items.plain_english: Then, having arranged the purification as before, one should perform a clockwise circumambulation of the village and other such places.
